mapper.select: SELECT n.neighbor_id AS neighborId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, AS profileFileId, n.status AS status, 'FOLLOW' AS listType FROM ( SELECT neighbor_id, receiver_user_no AS other_user_no, status, accepted_at AS sort_at FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' UNION ALL SELECT neighbor_id, requester_user_no, status, followed_back_at FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND followed_back = 1 ) n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.other_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY n.sort_at DESC, n.neighbor_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.neighbor_id AS neighborId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, AS profileFileId, n.status AS status, 'FOLLOWER' AS listType FROM ( SELECT neighbor_id, requester_user_no AS other_user_no, status, accepted_at AS sort_at FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' UNION ALL SELECT neighbor_id, receiver_user_no, status, followed_back_at FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND followed_back = 1 ) n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.other_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY n.sort_at DESC, n.neighbor_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
